signals.text: 2 open PM roles across 1 US office
Recently added to Tolara — hiring trends need a week of history

bullets: Own execution on Payouts end-to-end, from ACH today toward same-day pay and new payment methods
Take a well-scoped problem and run with it — you'll be trusted to execute thoroughly and with strong judgment, not just to check boxes
Sweat the details: catch edge cases before they ship and hold a high bar for quality, with minimal need for rework
Know when to make the call yourself and when to loop in your manager — escalation judgment matters as much as independent execution
Partner closely with your dedicated engineering counterpart and cross-functional teams (engineering, operations, partners) to ship reliably
Define and prioritize projects that make our payroll infrastructure more powerful and more resilient as we scale
Lead product execution with a bold, opinionated approach, pushing the boundaries of payroll solutions while addressing customer challenges with urgency
Engage with cross-functional experts from our business, engineering, and payroll operations teams to align on strategic goals
Connect directly with Check’s partners—software companies across diverse verticals—to understand their daily challenges and identify opportunities for scaling their payroll…
Develop a comprehensive roadmap in partnership with engineering and operations, outlining actionable strategies to build the infrastructure our partners need to scale
